dialogues.speaker: Chronie
dialogues.text: Why... Why does it have to be this way... How vile...

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! You're here! How wonderful... It's you... At least you know the truth...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Calm down, Ms. Chronie. Are... are you okay?

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Even... Even if my article doesn't get published...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's the matter with your article?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We were wondering when we'd finally see it!

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Didn't see it... Didn't see it, right, that's right, you probably didn't see it...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You seem... to be a bit flustered?

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: It's like this... Ever since I got back from the Fontaine Research Institute, I started writing my article.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: I put everything I saw, heard, and felt into that draft.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Such as how the Institute had never completely removed the Arkhium, but instead restarted another Arkhium-related research project.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Someone who used to work under Edwin was sent to explore the Institute ruins, but lost his life in an explosion.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Senior Technician Raimondo refused to confirm his death and insisted the explosion was a planned part of the project.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Plus the out-of-control giant machine in the ruins, and the polluted water...

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Everything that the Fontaine Research Institute wanted to cover up, I detailed it all in the article!

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: But... after I submitted it, I was told the Institute filed a lawsuit against me!

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: According to editorial regulations, everything I reported about the Fontaine Research Institute in the article must undergo a credibility review.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: And my article about Fontaine Research Institute was rejected...

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: No, the review didn't target any specific report, but me personally...

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Simply put, the Fontaine Research Institute accused me of inserting my own subjective emotions into the report due to conflicts of interest with the Institute and spreading false information to the public...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But... do you have a conflict of interest with the Institute?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She only took a few pictures of worn rocks and broken machines... What conflict of interest could there possibly be?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Because you exposed their unethical practices?

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: They... They accused me of leaking the latest design in the Fonta line.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: They insisted that some of the photos I took in the ruins revealed parts of the latest Fonta design.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: They must thoroughly examine every photo. Until then, they won't withdraw the lawsuit and I must continue to be subject to the credibility review.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: It's obviously a ploy to stop my article from going public... but I will not give up.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Here, take this！ It's a copy of the newspaper I printed secretly. I'll distribute more copies soon.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: I have to inform everyone about the truth behind the Fontaine Research Institute, and...

response.speaker: Muirne
response.text: Ms. Chronie! What are you still doing here? I've been looking everywhere for you.

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Oh no, somebody's coming. I can't stay here...

response.speaker: Chronie
response.text: Here's a copy, keep it safe. I wrote the true story in it! All of it!

response.speaker: Muirne
response.text: According to the rules, you must go to the Maison Gestion for your routine review now...

response.speaker: Muirne
response.text: Hey, please don't run away, Ms. Chronie!

response.speaker: Muirne
response.text: It's only Fonta, and it's probably just a misunderstanding! If you just explain...

response.speaker: Muirne
response.text: Wait! Please stop, Ms. Chronie!

choices.text: Doesn't your paper believe your report was reliable?
